1. (Currently amended) A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: a computing device including a processor coupled to a system memory, the system memory storing instructions for execution on the processor, the instructions configured to cause the processor to: retrieve a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain __from a plurality of heterogeneous data sources including at least one of network flow data, DNS query logs, or BGP routing tables__; analyze the network data __using a machine learning model trained on historical threat data__ and identify a malicious network threat; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat __by implementing at least one of null routing, access control list modification, or network isolation__.

5.
